observations: Multiple stacks of used tires in an outdoor market setting.
Tires are covered in dirt and mud, indicating recent use or storage in a dusty environment.
Tread depth is visible but cannot be measured accurately from a distance.
Tires are stacked in piles, suggesting bulk inventory rather than individual sale.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'IKWE ANTHONY' is visible on all photos.

claims.evidence: The origin and quality grade are not visible on the tires in the photos.

claims.claim: Tread is still 90 percent, no patch, no bulge. Removed from a 2023 car.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Tread depth may be significantly reduced.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the tread on the bottom of the tires.
risks.if_unproven: as having very low tread depth

risks.risk: Tires may have internal damage or structural defects.
risks.proof: A video of a professional tire balancer or a professional tire inspector.

risks.risk: The tires may be expired or past their service life.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the DOT code on the sidewall.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the sidewall of the tires to read the brand, model, and DOT code.
Photos of the tread on the bottom of the tires to assess wear.
A photo of the tires on a wheel rim to check for sidewall damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
